services.title: Ceramic tint
services.body: Ceramic film cuts the heat without going dark, and it is cut to the glass rather than the roll.

reviews.author: kevin kissel
reviews.text: Absolutely great service, quick and friendly! Great job, tint is PERFECT! Save time and money, come here first. Saidou is amazing!

reviews.author: Jesse Kenealy
reviews.text: The absolute best tint place in the triad and worth the drive from about anywhere! Window Tint Center has done all my and my buddy’s cars without a single issue. Friendly people, amazing quality of work, and surprisingly great prices. You will need to be scheduled in, so call beforehand.

reviews.author: Bryan Kospender
reviews.text: Very nice owner with great prices! Sometimes you have to wait a week or two for an appointment but that's a good thing. He stays busy for a reason.

reviews.author: Ryan Antkowiak
reviews.text: I recently failed a state safety inspection because my window tints were too dark. I came here to have them stripped and redone to be within state regulations. The guys running the shop were very friendly and knowledgeable, especially regarding the state laws and recent changes. They were quick (I was in and out in about an hour) and did a great job. I’m very happy with the way the new tints turned out, and they beat all the other quotes I received by $100. Can’t recommend this place enough.

reviews.author: Charlotte Freeman
reviews.text: This review is overdue....The Owner - Saido was not only very professional but a very sweet and polite guy. And I'm going to say he did a FABULOUS job. I was so glad I went to him. I had another appointment to go somewhere else, but I remember a friend telling me about this location, so at the last minute I googled it and his ratings looked great so I figured I'd try him out instead. Oh, and he was cheaper then Tint World too. I would Highly...did you hear me, I would highly recommend you go to him for your window tinting needs. He is the Bomb!!! Thank you so very much...KUDOS!!!!

reviews.author: Romesh Singh
reviews.text: Fast in and out tinting! Make your appointment show up and walk out in no time. Great place for your window tint!

reviews.author: Kyle Underhill
reviews.text: Saidou is one of the nicest guys you will meet. My family and I have had him tint over 20 vehicles and I have never seen anyone be able to hand cut tint to the precision he does. So glad I only live 10 mins from the shop. If you had your windows tinted ANYWHERE else, you paid TOO much and received inferior quality and service.

reviews.author: John Reiland
reviews.text: I just brought my new Subaru here for window tinting of the front door windows. This is my second time using Window Tint Center. Both times the job was fabulous. I have had friends check it out and they have agreed that the job was done perfectly. This time I waited in the lobby while he did the job. I just want to recommend the Window Tint Center to anyone looking for this kind of work. This is a locally owned small business.

reviews.author: Miguel Jimenez
reviews.text: Outstanding quality and service. Most likely the best craftsmanship that you can get in GBO. The owner installs with pride, and care that reflects on the fact that he has won National competitions. Expect an extraordinary service, a flawless install, and both a friendly and genuine service that I found hard to match compared to other shops. I have all of my family member cars done here due to consistent quality and service.

reviews.author: Alec Westmoreland
reviews.text: Had to get my car detinted so it could pass inspection. I called and they had me drop it off and they worked on it in between other appointment they had and had it done by the end of the day. It was a good price, far better than other quotes I received and the work was amazing! They're very friendly and were easy to work with!

reviews.author: Donna Wilder
reviews.text: These guys did a great job on my 2017 Elantra. Almost half the price of the other places I checked. Low overhead and passing the savings to the customer. I arrived, they had an opening and my car was finished in an hour and 15 minutes. Very friendly and professional. Car looks fantastic.

reviews.author: Carli B
reviews.text: Excellent all around!! Saidu (I believe that's his name) was kind, efficient, professional, and fast. He's done 4 of our vehicles over the past few years, all of which are seamless, and his pricing is quite competitive. 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Joseph Perry
reviews.text: Very nice guys. My wife had her suv done here. They beat every ones price around by a large margin and tinted 7 windows for less than $200. I made an appointment and they got us in two days later. When we dropped the truck off the man said two hours and had it ready in less than two hours. Very friendly and professional. Highly recommended these guys.

reviews.author: Anthony Vogt
reviews.text: This shop is A1 professional! He did a great job with my vehicle was quick and fair, and even squeezed me in! I will recommend him to all my friends and be bringing my other vehicles back to him! Don’t go anywhere else!

reviews.author: Leroy Walker
reviews.text: They guys did an excellent job and at an even better price. Will definitely use them again in the future. Just an FYI, you have to make an appointment because they are really busy. It may be a week or two before they can get to you.

reviews.author: Kincaid
reviews.text: Saidou and his partner did an incredible job on my vehicle. I can’t even begin to explain how good the window tint came out. The prices were amazing, the quality was amazing and the guys were top notch and very professional! Highly recommend! Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Joseph Tran
reviews.text: Editing my review from 5 stars to 2. The tint on my back window has started to bubble 2 years later. I called the location and they advised me to come in to have it looked at. Went to the location and waited in the lobby for 45 minutes with no one coming out. Ended up leaving and haven't had time to revisit the location since to have my window looked at.

reviews.author: Seth Gleason
reviews.text: Got it today. Amazing job! I already had tint on my car when I brought it few months ago. I decided I needed new tint because of blurry and bubbles on them. The rear windsheild was hardest to remove but he did it and put new tint on. They were coming off in pieces. Looks amazing! Feels so different in my car now. I wish I could give 10/5. Highly recommended. My brother goes to him for tint all the time! Will be there again if I ever want to go darker tint than what I have now!

reviews.author: Unknown Person
reviews.text: I have had 2 Cars tinted here! I would not take my cars any place else. These guys take the time to do it right. Great Business, Job, and best all great Value!! Tell them you saw this Review!

reviews.author: Casey Smatana
reviews.text: Saidou does a great job and the price is the best you will find in town. I had the 20% ceramic installed on my 2018 Accord. The tint is factory quality too. I had the high grade 3M on my last car and it wasn’t as nice as this. I will be recommending anyone interested in window tint to Saidou. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Jacob Lowery
reviews.text: I would recommend this window tint specialist to all! As a matter of fact I was so satisfied with the final result that I scheduled an appointment for my fiancé to get her windows tinted as well. My appointment time was at 2pm, I got there a little early and he was just finishing up another customers tint and went right into mine before the actual time of my appointment. This guy is the real deal! Thanks for my tint!

reviews.author: Jeremy Hughes
reviews.text: Super happy with my window tint. Saidou was friendly, quick, and did an awesome job. Definitely recommend

reviews.author: Virginia Walker
reviews.text: I was running late to my appointment with gps lol but the owner was very patient and very honest. He informed me of what was legal/illegal before I continued with my services. I definitely recommend. Like they say you have to wait a little while for an appointment for a reason, nothing better than an honest man who does the job right! Thank you again!

reviews.author: Amber M
reviews.text: I came here without "shopping around" because the reviews were so great... and they were right! I came in for my back windows to keep my new baby out of the sun (nothing too dark) and Mr. Saidu let me come in on a Sunday to accommodate my schedule. Don't be intimidated by the location.. give this place a chance for quality tint and a great price!!

reviews.author: Dani Iqbal
reviews.text: My shop of choice for tints. My family and I have gotten more than 10 cars done here and all walked away happy. Saidou works efficiently, uses quality tints and prices his work fairly. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: tracey todd
reviews.text: Love, love this place. I have no issues. Easy to what an appointment and u get ur car back fast. Won’t be disappointed

reviews.author: Don C
reviews.text: I've had all my work vehicles tinted here, all my personal and family member's cars and recommended him to many friends. Hands down one of the best in the business. Very professional - you wont be disappointed.

reviews.author: Jwillz Commonsence
reviews.text: I’ve had my f-150 and today my GMC tinted here. He’s fast and consistent! 20 minutes usually and your out! I drive 35 minutes. Best place!

reviews.author: Gee Will
reviews.text: This guy is the best! Ive taken 3 of my cars to him over a course of 10yrs and eventhough he gives a lifetime guarantee on his work I've never had 1 issue with my tint. I wouldn't let anyone else touch my tint but him!

reviews.author: jcoleslaw
reviews.text: They did a really good job for a really good price. I recommend getting these guys to install your window tint.

reviews.author: Carla Douglas
reviews.text: Best tint job I've ever had ,he came in early so I could get my car done got my whip looking good !! Yall go to the Window Tint Center u will be happy

reviews.author: Taylor P
reviews.text: I have used this place on my last 3 vehicles, they are simply the best in the triad, with the most reasonable prices by far. I send everyone I know here! Been a loyal customer since 2011!

reviews.author: James Bowman
reviews.text: Bomb job! Absolutely the best hands down... Quality, price and time! 2nd car done here... Wouldn't recommend anywhere else and I live an hr away and come all the to Greensboro for them to tint my car!

reviews.author: Faith
reviews.text: Very professional and nice he did a great job on my car. He explained everything I needed to know before and after. Will be taking my second vehicle here also.

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.text: This is the absolute best place to get a tint. I was really happy with how my windows came out, and that made me decide to get my windshield next. Great customer service as well. Thank you!

reviews.author: Darren Kim
reviews.text: Man the guy at the front desk was super friendly and helped me pick out the exact % tint I needed. Really quick and quality work that’s for sure. I highly recommend. Support small businesses!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Jorge Ayala
reviews.text: I have a 2015 altima that I got in 2015 and the tint he did in 2015 looks the same as the day he put it on! I just got a 2021 altima and I had to go back! Tint doesn't fade and the quality is unmatched. I strongly recommend coming here to get your tint done. You won't be disappointed

reviews.author: carol walker
reviews.text: Have had 2 cars done here and he is hands down the best!!!! Taking my daughter in laws car this weekend to get them done for her Christmas present! So that will be 3

reviews.author: Andrea Honrado
reviews.text: Saidou did the tint on my SUV and he is very efficient and very professional and does a great job. I highly recommend to have your car tinted here. Thank you.

reviews.author: Perry Saunders
reviews.text: I had a ceramic tint placed on my 2013 Toyota Camry SE. He took his time and done it right. Prices were decent and I was pleased with the outcome.

reviews.author: Monroe Smith
reviews.text: Mr. Saidou was very nice , professional and it was great doing business with him as he is extremely reasonable. If anyone in the Triad needs their windows tinted you should give this business a chance.!!!!

reviews.author: tim
reviews.text: So far driving away looks great... so my car is the white hyundai sonata in the pics.. to this day it's still perfect and I would tell anyone to go to him

reviews.author: Airon Phoenix
reviews.text: They did the front 2 windows on my Jeep Cherokee about 6 years ago. It's the best tint job I've seen and still looks great to this day.

reviews.author: Chris Dougherty
reviews.text: Great customer service and workmanship. I walked in and they fit me into their schedule on the spot. Very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Since 5 Creations
reviews.text: Excellent work, very pleased with the work and great customer service. Got full ceramic all the way around. Very happy with the outcome.

reviews.author: Leland Barber
reviews.text: Professional quality and great pricing. I have used Window Tint Center on several vehicles and I am always happy with the results.

reviews.author: Queen bash
reviews.text: Very nice squeezed me in his tight schedule! overall service and time of wait was not bad at all would definitely recommend!!!

reviews.author: Shaunte' Blackwell
reviews.text: By far the best tint job ever. These guys are on point. Great customer service as well. My first choice now for any tint job in the future. Thanks guys.

reviews.author: Henry Bradley
reviews.text: This is the type of business I feel lucky finding. Really nice guy, incredible work, & such a good value!

reviews.author: Jason Miles (SmoothBassman)
reviews.text: Awesome work! Got me in the next day and put on a great set of SunTex films. Awesome work. Check them out.

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.text: Great guys doing it the old fashioned way and doing it right! Very professional and even the waiting room had comfy seats

reviews.author: Benjamin Swanson
reviews.text: Way overpriced. And they just kept adding on fees and taxes when I got there. Would definitely not go back.

reviews.author: John Reddick
reviews.text: Always good never had an issues at all. Been with him since he started at sound solutions back in the day

reviews.author: Nicole Townsend
reviews.text: I called after another company failed to do my tint.they got me in fast and the service is excellent. Thank you guys soooo much

reviews.author: Nelly Ramos
reviews.text: Best window tint center of the triad! Very professional, they help you find the best solution for a reasonable price.

reviews.author: Cererage
reviews.text: The guy tells me on the phone to come in at 6pm and he’s not even here while the doors and everything is locked. Also mentioning the fact that the store says open and they really close at 7pm. I call their phone again and suddenly nobody is answering while the whole store says open

reviews.author: Mike R
reviews.text: Good guy / place Had a window that dried wrong or something happened but he filled me in few minutes later I’m good . My 2nd time over the years here
